data.content: {"requirements":[{"unit_ids":["u1"],"source_quote":"The file must reflect the currently applied filters and sorting.","kind":"functional","statement":"The exported Excel file must contain only the rows matching the currently applied filters, in the currently applied sort order."},{"unit_ids":["u2"],"source_quote":"Clear column headers and consistent date formatting.","kind":"constraint","statement":"Every exported Excel file must have clear column headers and use one consistent date format across all date columns."},{"unit_ids":["u3"],"source_quote":"Filename must include the generation timestamp.","kind":"functional","statement":"The name of each exported Excel file must include the timestamp at which the file was generated."},{"unit_ids":["u4"],"source_quote":"User-friendly message if there is no data to export.","kind":"frontend","statement":"When there is no data to export, the system must show a message to the user instead of producing an empty file. The PRD does not define the message wording or whether a file is still produced; this is an open question."}]}
